source: multichannel: VERBATIM OpenAPI example (https://api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json, MultichannelSpeechToTextResponseModel); webhook/202: VERBATIM OpenAPI 202 example + SpeechToTextWebhookResponseModel (SDK api/types/SpeechToTextWebhookResponseModel.d.ts, 2.71.0); webhook POST payload shape per https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/guides/how-to/speech-to-text/batch/webhooks; silence: COMPOSED GUESS (no doc states what silent audio returns). Accessed 2026-10-07.
kind: rest-responses (reference: shapes coax must not mistake for a transcript)

webhook_accepted_202.message: Request accepted. Transcription result will be sent to the webhook.

expect.multichannel: Only returned when use_multi_channel=true AND multichannel_output_style='separate' (default). coax never sends use_multi_channel, so it never sees this shape unless a caller forces it - then body.text is undefined. 'combined' returns the flat single-channel shape with channel_index per word.
expect.webhook: Only when webhook=true; carries no text. coax never sends webhook. The SDK's convert() typings return this union member only for webhook:true.
expect.silence: Empty text is a legitimate transcript of silence, not a refusal - unverified guess, no doc found.
